title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Data Platform Engineer

London (Hybrid - 3 days per week in office)

£90,000 + Benefits

We're partnering with a fast-growing, technology-led organisation that is investing heavily in its data and AI capabilities. As part of this journey, they're looking for a Data Platform Engineer to take ownership of a newly built Azure Databricks platform and play a key role in its long-term success.

This is an opportunity to join at the beginning of a major data transformation programme, working closely with senior technology leaders to shape platform operations, scalability, security and future growth.

The Role

You'll be responsible for operating and improving a cloud-based data platform built on Azure and Databricks, ensuring it remains secure, scalable and reliable for engineering, analytics and AI teams. The role combines platform engineering, infrastructure automation, systems integration and operational support.

Key responsibilities:

  • Managing Azure infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Supporting and optimising Azure Databricks environments, governance and platform operations.
  • Maintaining networking, security and connectivity across cloud services.
  • Building and supporting integrations with business-critical systems and third-party platforms.
  • Managing CI/CD processes and engineering tooling.
  • Monitoring platform health, investigating incidents and driving continuous improvements.
  • Working with internal stakeholders and delivery partners to transition ownership and enhance the platform over time.

Requirements:

  • Azure platform engineering and cloud infrastructure management.
  • Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Azure Databricks administration or platform support.
  • Data platforms, lakehouse architectures and SQL.
  • CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions.
  • API integrations and systems connectivity.
  • Cloud security, identity and access management.
  • Python

Why Apply?

  • Join during a major data and AI transformation programme.
  • Work with modern Azure and Databricks technologies.
  • Influence the future direction of a growing data platform.
  • High visibility role with significant ownership and autonomy.
  • Fast-paced environment with strong career progression opportunities.
  • Opportunity to help scale a growing technology function from the ground up
